text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and design better software. Testing also gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they can change the code without fear of breaking things. In short, good testing saves time and makes better software.
